value: THE over_declared_overlaps BUCKET OF THE T7 EXTERN-SIZE CENSUS MIXES THREE DIFFERENT DEFECTS PLUS A FALSE-POSITIVE CLASS, AND ONLY THE TARGET'S OWN ADDRESSING FORM SEPARATES THEM. Worked end to end run 38 over the 8 live rows (the record's stated 9 was already stale -- select.c:101 had been fixed by the UC/UB pair, so re-run the census rather than trusting the count). CLASS 1, THE MAP FRAGMENTED ONE OBJECT: the interior symbols have ZERO references in any C source and appear in no .s file but the split output, and the fragments TILE the declared extent exactly. gPlayers is the type case -- dtk recorded size:0x9F1 (2545, not even divisible by 4) and placed lbl_802764D1 and lbl_80278B8B at unaligned addresses inside it, the three tiling to 0x80275AE0 + 0xCD70 = 0x80282850 exactly, while the target's own calc_wizard_pos walks the array with `addi r4,r4,13148` = 0x335C. lbl_80346C48 is the same class in .sdata2, where the split cut a string literal in half. FIX THE MAP. CLASS 2, A GENUINE SOURCE OVER-DECLARATION: the split data itself gives the true length and the consumer only decays the array to a pointer. lbl_80346AA0 is `.string "L1"` (3 bytes) declared [8]; lbl_803473FC is `.string "Inv"` (4 bytes) declared [6]. FIX THE BOUND. Both stayed at or below MWCC's 8-byte small-data threshold on each side, so neither was score-visible -- unlike UB's select.c row, where 12-vs-8 crossed the threshold and changed the addressing form. CLASS 3, BOTH SIDES CORRECT: the source spans two INDEPENDENTLY REFERENCED symbols through ONE base because the target does. game/world/btricol.c declares lbl_8023F7E8[8] to reach p1 at +16, and lbl_8023F7F8 is separately referenced 15 times in worldcol.c/gauntworld.c with its own lis/addi. Converting the six accesses to lbl_8023F7F8[0..2] was measured and REGRESSED: the aligned raw view shows the target holding ONE base, `lis/addi @lbl_8023F7E8` into r29 then `lfs f0,16(r29)`, where the converted form emits `lis/addi @lbl_8023F7F8` into r6 then `lfs f0,0(r6)`, additionally shifting an FPR (f23 -> f24) and breaking the shared web; the WebFrank pin on BTriLineCol refused the changed body hash, which is the guard working. DO NOT EDIT EITHER SIDE of a class-3 row. THE ONE-COMMAND DISCRIMINATOR, which no score supplies: `python tools/gdl/fnasm.py <unit> <fn> --ours --raw --diff` and read whether the TARGET reaches the aliased region as base+displacement or as its own relocation; combine it with a reference count on the interior symbol (zero C references => class 1; referenced => class 2 or 3).
